新增能力路由与异步任务闭环，修复失效引用、Token 泄漏和 Skill 元数据兼容性
补全中文文档，更新目录结构

Initial release of Dataify YouTube Video Post collection skill.

- Provides a guided workflow for submitting YouTube video post collection tasks to Dataify Builder.
- Supports six collection modes: by channel Videos URL, search filters, hashtag, podcast URL, keyword, and Explore URL.
- Handles API TOKEN requirements and instructs users on how to provide or set the token.
- Prompts user step-by-step: mode selection, parameter customization, multi-group collection, and confirmation.
- After submission, shows task ID and status, and directs user to Dataify dashboard for results.
